title: Stale Open Issue Backlog
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:issue issue_status="open" days_open=*
| where days_open>30
| stats count as stale_issues, max(days_open) as oldest_days by repo_name label
| sort - stale_issues
| head 20
description: Counts open GitHub issues older than thirty days grouped by repository and label.
value: Stale issues become silent debt that makes repos feel abandoned to future contributors or employers.
implementation: Export issues with `days_open` and `label`, then triage the top twenty stale items each sprint.
visualization: Bar chart of stale issue count by repo.
grandmaExplanation: It watches GitHub issues that have been open so long they probably need closing or fixing.
